details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:515-553 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: seed_git() packs the full HEAD tree into the synthetic Git repository, including tracked files excluded from the read-only snapshot’s secret-path filters.
  WHY: An agent can retrieve filtered files such as `.env` with `git show HEAD:.env`, bypassing the snapshot filter; severity is critical (BLOCKER), while Gemini, OpenAI, and Z-AI rated it major.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:268-318 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: snapshot_workspace() copies regular files without applying the secret-path filters used by snapshot_readonly().
  WHY: Workspace-mode agents can read secret-looking files copied into the workspace; severity is critical (BLOCKER), while OpenAI and Z-AI rated it major.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:556-573 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: copy_include() copies regular files without applying the secret-path filters used by snapshot_readonly().
  WHY: Read-only agents using included source trees can read secret-looking files from those trees.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:102-103 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `+/-` character range in valid_path() admits commas, which Docker parses as separators in `--mount` values.
  WHY: A path containing a comma can cause Docker mount parsing to fail or allow unintended mount options; DeepSeek and Qwen rated this confidence 4.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8658-8662 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: invoke_judge_for_integration_conflict() masks _integration_judge_commit_and_push failures and unconditionally returns success.
  WHY: The caller can treat a failed commit or push as resolved, reset the unresolved counter, and delay escalation; Qwen rated this major, while the other reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8689 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `git add -u` does not stage new untracked files created during conflict resolution.
  WHY: A pushed resolution can omit files needed by the changes; Gemini and DeepSeek rated this confidence 4, while Minimax and Z-AI rated it 3.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:281-289, 366-374 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A persistent sandbox run does not remove a stale provider socket before broker startup, and the readiness loop accepts an existing socket as ready.
  WHY: After an interrupted run, the stale socket can make startup proceed even though the broker failed to bind; Minimax and Z-AI rated this confidence 4.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8698-8705 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: If reading STATE_FILE fails, the fingerprint-verification code substitutes `{}` and skips verification.
  WHY: A malformed or unavailable state file can allow an integration resolution to be committed and pushed without the promised intent checks; Gemini and Minimax rated this major, while DeepSeek rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:470-504 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: transfer() deletes host files and directories before writing replacements, without rolling back if a later write fails.
  WHY: A rejected transfer can leave the host tree partially modified; DeepSeek, Minimax, and Qwen rated this confidence 4.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2600-2632, 3631-3660, 5172-5182, 5661-5676 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The workflow creates a persistent sandbox root but does not clean it up at job end.
  WHY: Sandbox copies and virtual environments can accumulate on self-hosted runners and exhaust disk; DeepSeek and Z-AI rated this nit, while Z-AI rated confidence 3 and Minimax rated confidence 4.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:386-396 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The Docker containers do not receive `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`.
  WHY: Python bytecode caches can accumulate inside the sandbox and violate the repository’s bytecode-cache convention.
- agents.md:1250 and 1449-1625 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: CODEX_ISOLATION is listed in the human-readable stable log-prefix list but is missing from the machine-readable LOG_PREFIX.name= entries.
  WHY: Downstream tooling that classifies log lines from the machine-readable entries will not recognize the new prefix.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:88-105 and 531-534 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: seed_git() does not remove GIT_COMMON_DIR from the environment used for Git operations in the synthetic repository.
  WHY: In a worktree environment, Git operations may use or mutate the host repository’s common Git directory instead of the isolated destination.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8510-8513 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The merge command’s `|| true` masks failures unrelated to merge conflicts.
  WHY: A failed merge can be mistaken for a conflict-free result, causing the judge to be skipped and the integration resolution path to proceed incorrectly.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:339-346 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The codex-home directory is mounted writable into the container.
  WHY: Agent-written configuration or session state can persist on the host and affect later runs; Z-AI rated this nit.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:274-279, 399-403; scripts/clarify_openrouter_broker.py:80-88 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Isolated runs default to `web_search=live`, and the broker forwards tool configuration unchanged to OpenRouter.
  WHY: Provider-hosted web search can make external requests despite `--network none`, allowing injected instructions to place sensitive data in a search query.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1507-1518 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The local hook lacks the `_LOOP_HEADER_RE` and `_is_approvable_read_loop` exceptions present in the workflow-template copy.
  WHY: The template parity tests fail, causing seven failures in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` and blocking the CI check.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1506-1517 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: evaluate() returns ASK for commands with `_shell_rewrite_hazard` before checking the literal-ID read-loop allowance.
  WHY: Vetted literal-ID read loops are treated as hazardous, and the read-loop tests expect them to be allowed.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:269-273 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Under isolation, the default session-root path can differ between the marker reader and the next call when CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_SESSION_ROOT is unset.
  WHY: Thread-reuse sessions can be silently dropped when one path is written and a different path is read.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8500-8512, 21026-21029 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The integration judge worktree is removed without checking whether a judge from the previous tick is still using it.
  WHY: A concurrent poll tick can remove the worktree while the earlier judge container is writing to it, causing partial state or a corrupted index.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "the agent never holds GH_PAT, the OpenRouter key or the checkout's .git, and has no network access" (PR description, design section).
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:seed_git
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: seed_git repacks the host's full HEAD tree, including tracked secret blobs; the synthetic .git lets the agent retrieve them with `git show HEAD:.env`.
- requirement: "every Codex agent that reads untrusted text runs isolated" (PR description, Q1–Q11 = A).
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:snapshot_workspace
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: snapshot_workspace filters `.git` and prep_roots but not secret-looking paths; implement agents in workspace mode can read `.env`, `secrets/`, and secret-suffix files.
- requirement: "Agents that read untrusted text" (PR description) + "agent never falls back to running on the host" (no off switch).
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:284-289
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Persistent-root startup can accept a stale provider.sock as ready without verifying that a fresh broker process exists.
- requirement: “Claude engine branch (Q12 = B): it lands in this PR once PR #6174 merges (`claude_run` through the container plus `claude_anthropic_relay.py`).”
  expected_change_site: `scripts/ai_engine.sh::claude_run` and its integration with `scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py`.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The last commit merges PR #6174, but neither file is in the PR changed-files list. The current `claude_run` still directly invokes `claude` and exports `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` at `scripts/ai_engine.sh:271-285`; this PR adds no container or relay wiring there.
- requirement: "CI / LINT CHECK-RUN FAILURES — when the header reports failed_count > 0, every listed failure is a concrete defect" — CI reports `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` failing with 7 tests in `test_gh_api_write_guard.py`.
  expected_change_site: The failure originates from `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` changes (the `hazard and not _LOOP_HEADER_RE.match(command)` modification) brought in by the merge commit, not from this PR's direct diff.
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description acknowledges "The remaining failures fail the same way on `main`"; the PR's own changes do not touch `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`. The source says to cite this as a blocking CI failure but not as a task gap.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  WHY: An agent can retrieve filtered tracked files with `git show HEAD:.env` or similar.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh: valid_path() at line 102-103 | severity=high | confidence=4
